request: is ordinary-source u64 fixed or supported now
answer_opening: Producer master and the v0.0.21 product compiler both support ordinary-source u64; read release.json for the currently published lifecycle stage.
u32: included in the v0.0.21 product compiler; no repair was required
char: not implemented on the cited producer authority and not released; arbitrary u32 is not a char substitute
stop: Report u64 support only for the v0.0.21 product compiler. Do not infer async, map, char, lifecycle stage or installation from scalar support.
